name: Chick-fil-A Chicken Noodle Soup
whyItWorks: A classic road-trip soothing bowl made with tender shredded chicken breast, soft egg noodles, and diced carrots simmered in chicken broth. Gentle on an irritated digestive tract and easily digested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for a bowl with a spoon. Skip the saltine crackers if sensitive to gluten, or crush a few into the broth.
